title: Unstage Ticket Folder Without Restart
description: Unstaging .\ud83e\uddecsemio/\ud83e\uddb0\ufe0frepo/\ud83c\udf9ftickets/\ud83c\udf86\ufe0f26/\ud83c\udf19\ufe0f09/\u2600\ufe0f23 in GitKraken restarts the Mac. The day tree is polluted, mostly by END-TO-END-OS-HUB-COLLABORATION-MCP: about 6.7GB, 33k staged files, a 4GB w3-backup of repo snapshots, debug binaries over 100MB, and node_modules symlinks. Remove that pollution and take those paths out of the index so unstaging the folder no longer crashes the machine. Keep ticket reports and small scripts.
summary: Unstaged the 23 September ticket day and removed the staged 4GB w3-backup, debug binaries, generated dumps, and node_modules symlinks that made GitKraken restart the Mac. The day tree is 83MB with nothing staged. w3-backup is gitignored.
